# Lucide icons

- Package: `lucide@0.468.0`
- Upstream: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
- File: unmodified `dist/umd/lucide.min.js` from the published npm package
- License: ISC, with Feather/MIT attribution; see `LICENSE` and the bundle header
- Download source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide@0.468.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js

Served locally, deferred before `app.js`; there is no runtime CDN dependency or
frontend package/build-system requirement. Text labels remain when JavaScript is
unavailable. Icons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

To upgrade, pin a new release, replace the bundle and license together, and run
the Maven suite and `scripts/ui_smoke.py`. Do not replace it with an unpinned CDN URL.
